config_file.description: Path to the Yi configuration file.

frontend.description: Select frontend interface. One of: vty, gtk, pango, cocoa.

line_number.description: Start the editor on a given line number.

key_bindings_profile.description: Start with key bindings of a given editor (e.g., vi, emacs). Empty string for defaults.

debug_mode.description: Enable debug mode to write debug information in a log file.

resume.description: Resume execution of Yi from previous state.
